title: One status role, two colours: error, success and warning each render in two shades across states
claim: Within one theme, the error role renders as #b3261e (status pill tone-crit, status_fallback) and #ca4c46 (pin/save failure lines and dearer deltas), success as #1c7350 (pill) and #24845d (cheaper/saved lines, light), and warning as #8a5a00 (pill tone-warn) and #ffa600 (the wood alert's stripe, the same in dark): 5 (theme, role) pairs with two colours across the 50 states.
mechanism: The token layer (CARD_TOKENS --hpo-crit/--hpo-ok/--hpo-warn) drives the status pill, while the what-if result lines take the older ERROR_READABLE/SUCCESS_READABLE constants interpolated into cardStyleBlock, and the wood/space-blocked alerts carry inline styles reading Home Assistant's --warning-color directly (border-left:3px solid var(--warning-color,#d98e00)), so one meaning is painted from three palettes.

evidence.machine: box B10 (4 vCPU, Linux, Chromium 1243 via playwright 1.63.0, Node 22)
evidence.contention_note: ran beside the seat's own grid runs; a count, contention-immune
evidence.unit: count of (theme, status role) pairs whose rendered colour set has more than one member

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js:cardStyleBlock (ERROR_READABLE/SUCCESS_READABLE interpolation, .status-pill.tone-*) and the wood-alert inline style, as Chromium computes them
metric_definition: (theme, role) pairs, role from class (dearer|tone-crit|… = error; cheaper|tone-ok = ok; tone-warn|wood-alert = warn), whose text colour or 2px+ left stripe takes >1 computed colour across states
phenomenon_property: Every element that signals one status (error, success, warning) renders that status in one colour per theme, from the token layer.

null_control.note: where the readable constant equals the token literal (SUCCESS_READABLE_DARK #1fad6b = --hpo-ok dark) the role shows one colour: the split is the second palette, not the role classifier

proposed_fix_scope: Point the result lines and the alert stripes at --hpo-crit/--hpo-ok/--hpo-warn (and their -bg pairs) and retire the *_READABLE literals, re-measuring contrast in the P9 grid.
criteria_statement: D4-criteria 'look professional' / P3 one look (D4.M3 colour tokens across states)
